title: Definition
body_md: The \textbf{adapted vector field} $v^\ast(x)\in T_x\mathcal{M}$ of a vector $v \in T_p\mathcal{M}$ is defined in a normal neighborhood $x \in U_p$ by parallel transporting $v$ along the unique geodesic between $x$ and $p$.
head: environment

label: thm:properties_exp
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:properties_exp}
        Let $(\mathcal{M}, \textsl{g})$ be a complete and connected Riemannian manifold. Let $\overline{U}_p$ be the (closed) set of vectors $v \in T_p\mathcal{M}$ for which $\gamma(t) = \exp_p(tv), t \in [0,1]$ is length minimizing, and let $U_p$ be its interior and $C_p$ its boundary. Then, $\exp_p$ is a diffeomorphism on $U_p$ and $\exp_p(C_p)$ has measure zero with respect to the Borel measure induced by $\textsl{g}$.
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md: See~\cite[Section 5.7.3]{petersen2016riemannian} for the first part. The second follows from~\cite{itoh1998dimension}.

label: prop:vector_field
title: Proposition
body_md:
\label{prop:vector_field}
        Let $(\mathcal{M}, \textsl{g})$ be a Riemannian manifold. Let $f$ be any differentiable function $f$ on $\mathcal{M}$, and let $p_0,p_i \in \mathcal{M}$ be some points and $v_{i,k} \in T_{p_i}\mathcal{M}$ with $x_t \coloneqq \exp_{p_i}(v_{i,k})$ such that $p_0, p_i \in U_{x_t}$ with $U_{x_t}$ as in~\Cref{thm:properties_exp}. Then, the map
        \[
            \dodeffunction\mathrm{d}\pa{\exp^{-1}_{p_0} \circ \exp_{p_i}}^\ast_{v_{i,k}} : T_{p_0}\mathcal{M} -> T_{p_i}\mathcal{M};\relax
        \]
        were $(-)^\ast$ is the adjoint, takes directions of steepest descent of $f \circ \exp_{p_0}$ to directions of steepest descent of $f \circ \exp_{p_i}$. Furthermore, it is the only map between $T_{p_0}\mathcal{M}$ and $T_{p_i}\mathcal{M}$ with this property.

title: Theorem
body_md:
Let $(\mathcal{M}, 	extsl{g})$ be a connected and complete Riemannian manifold with zeroth and first order curvature bounds $\delta \leq \sec \leq \Delta$ and $
orm{
abla R} \leq \Lambda$. Consider a connected submanifold $\mathcal{X}$ with $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{X}) = r$ where $r \leq  rac{\sqrt{2}\pi}{\sqrt{\delta + \Delta}}$ if $\Delta > - \delta$, and let $f$ be a function on $\mathcal{X}$ bounded below by $f^\ast \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $
orm{\operatorname{Hess} f} \leq \alpha$. Then, there exists a constant $\widehat{\alpha}_r$ that does not depend on the dimension of $\mathcal{M}$ such that $
orm{\operatorname{Hess} \pa{f \circ \exp_p}\vert_{\exp_p^{-1}\pa{\mathcal{X}}}} \leq \widehat{\alpha}_r$ for any $p \in \mathcal{X}$. Therefore, running 	extsc{atriv}$K$ with 	extsc{gd}{} and $\eta =  rac{1}{\widehat{\alpha}_r}$, if all the iterates stay in $\mathcal{X}$, the algorithm will find a point $v_{i, k} \in T_{p_i}\mathcal{M}$ such that $
orm{
abla \pa{f \circ \exp_{p_i}}(v_{i,k})} < \varepsilon$ in at most
        $\ceil[\Big]{\mbox{\@setsize\@setsize\@setsize\@setsize\@setsize\@setsize\@setsize\small{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt{10pt}\ixpt\@ixpt$\displaystyle rac{2\widehat{\alpha}_r}{\varepsilon^2}$}\pa{f(p_0) - f^\ast}}$
    steps.

title: Proof
body_md: The result follows from~\cite[Proposition $5.1$]{lezcano2020curvature} and the classical theory of non-convex optimization~\cite{nesterov2004introductory}.
head: environment

title: Remark
body_md: We do not include the adding problem or the copying problem~\cite{hochreiter1997long} which are often considered, as these problems are too simple for recurrent models~\cite{henaff2016recurrent}. All the considered optimization methods converge to a correct answer in the copying and adding problems.
